status: schema registry and source boundaries only; not an executed graph or qualification receipt
cutoff_semantics: input-domain exclusions, not whole-state terminal flags; no cutoff edge is silently discarded
closure: only emitted if BFS empties without cap, SQL, materialization, rollback, coverage or independent invariant failures
canonical: SHA256 of serde_json UTF8 serialization of {rows:one authoritative full-column snapshot,episode:exact captured identities/numeric values/budgets}; replace opaque generated job UUID strings with J0/J1 only

restrictions.ordinary_token_inputs: latest captured revision perclaim; old revisions retained in state and tested as conformance
restrictions.binding_completion_inputs: captured lease owner matches captured queue-token node
restrictions.node_domain_acquisition_inputs: node owns selected durable runningclaim; expiry races retained; foreignholder independent
restrictions.retirement_inputs: disposition 3 uses Some(worker_retired), None checkpoint and not_before_ms=current episode.now for every captured original token; ordinary dispositions 0/1/2 retain latest-revision inputs
restrictions.resolution_read_boundary: resolve_claim is one logical actual-API pure-read action; its two authoritative QueueSql awaits and internal interleavings are a named conformance boundary, not closed read-interleaving coverage
restrictions.primitive_clock_boundary: each generated primitive request uses current episode.now; the daemon's three retirement wall samples and dispatch/application races are reviewed adapter/conformance boundaries, not source-derived clock-race coverage
restrictions.reservation_conservation_boundary: conservation is checked for unexpired queue authority only; expired Running rows and residue remain represented, with no independent complete-residue conservation guarantee until reclaim/prune
restrictions.domain_reacquisition_boundary: each owner can acquire at most once; release or expiry does not reset its budget, so same-owner release-to-reacquire cycles are excluded
restrictions.foreign_holder_boundary: foreign-holder is a third adversarial domain-lease owner, not either worker node, with one independent acquisition budget
restrictions.retirement_sequence_boundary: the graph supplies separate actual settle and logical resolve primitives; daemon drain/local-token/first-settle/resolve/optional-second-settle sequencing is a reviewed source and daemon-conformance boundary composed by the temporal model
restrictions.cleanup_boundary: local cleanup needs bounded retirement calls to return, not eventual successful acknowledgement; errors are logged and finish returns while durable authority may remain
restrictions.retirement_settlement_inputs: disposition3 for every captured original token; ordinary0/1/2 still latest revision per claim
restrictions.resolve_inputs: all captured original identities; fence is Some(original.fence); request samples episode.now; no combined first-settle/resolve/second-settle operation
restrictions.selected_cancellation: no queue cancellation environment transition; CancelRequested and successful Cancel are conformance outside selected D
restrictions.dispatch_time_noninterference: for retirement fence Some(F), resolve_claim reads dispatched_at_ms only in its skipped fence-is-none window branch; neither SQL query nor later classification reads it, so a representative dispatch sample preserves results at fixed now/read outcomes; this is a reviewed source lemma, not a machine proof
restrictions.queue_sql_boundary: all generated queue primitives use QueueSql::queue_sql, not queue_transaction; ReplyBoundary passes queue_transaction through without fault injection, so multi-statement transaction faults are outside this slice
restrictions.schema_snapshot_boundary: canonical durable rows cover exactly the nine snapshot_tables; all installed schema objects are hash-bound for identity, not complete row snapshots or proofs of unrelated tables
restrictions.savepoint_boundary: no closure transition invokes queue_transaction or nested explicit transactions; test savepoints bracket sequential primitives on the production writer and any savepoint/SQL failure aborts closure
restrictions.refusal_observation: the existing BFS full-canonical equality guard already rejects every refused edge mutation; direct non-graph conformance can additionally enable apply's durable snapshot observer; no pre-existing closure gap is claimed

premises: completion opportunity before explicit attempt/domain/fault budgets exhaust
no infinite fresh-progress conclusion from two fixed selected requests
schema_bindings_hashes: SHA256 of compiled migration SQL UTF8 per1based version; SHA256 of ordered sqlite_schema JSON UTF8
savepoints: same production writer connection; all errors abort closure; actual commit-observation/durability and engine internals are boundary assumptions, separately conformance sampled

cost_bounds_by_definition.note: unmeasured conservative bound; normal BFS reuses its existing full-canonical refusal guard; only logical resolution always adds direct durable pre/post read checks; direct non-graph tests enable optional CAS observation

resolved_token_contract.resolve_running_or_cancel_requested: exact actual returned token interned by full equality at a stable per-job captured index; earlier indices never change
resolved_token_contract.identity: job_id,node_id,boot_id,claim_id,fence must equal the original input identity; revision and expiry may advance
resolved_token_contract.settled_payload: state/result_ref unused by retirement control; no returned retry token
resolved_token_contract.api_errors: separate reply/return fault boundary; actual SQLite API errors abort graph generation
